열.forms: native · counting things, hours, age · 11–19: 열하나, 열둘 … (열한 개, 열두 시)
열.e: Homonym: 열 also means heat or fever (열이 나요 = I have a fever).
열.t: Teens combine 열 + number: 열하나 (11), 열둘 (12). Before counters: 열한 시, 열두 시.

열.ex: 아이가 열이 나서 학교에 못 갔어요.
열.x: The child had a fever and couldn't go to school.
열.t: 'To have a fever' is 열이 나다. Don't confuse with the native number 열 (ten).

식당.x: I eat lunch at the restaurant in front of the school.
식당.t: Pronounced [식땅]. To call the server: 여기요!

기쁘다.x: I'm really happy to see my friend again.
기쁘다.e: 기뻐요 = I'm glad. 기쁨 = joy. Opposite: 슬프다.

세우다.m: to stop (a vehicle), to pull over; to stand (something) up; to make (a plan)
세우다.ex: 기사님, 저기 은행 앞에서 세워 주세요.
세우다.x: Driver, please pull over in front of the bank up there.
세우다.e: Causative of 서다 'to stand, to stop': make something stand or stop.
세우다.t: In a taxi, say "여기서 세워 주세요" ("Please stop here").

화내다.m: to get angry (at someone), to lose one's temper
화내다.x: My mom got angry because I came home late.
화내다.t: 화가 나다 is feeling angry; 화내다 is showing it, usually at someone: 저한테 화내지 마세요.

장갑.ex: 오늘은 밖이 많이 추우니까 장갑을 끼세요.
장갑.x: It's really cold outside today, so put on your gloves.
장갑.t: Gloves take the verb 끼다, not 입다: 장갑을 끼다 = to put on gloves.

아이디.x: I forgot my username, so I looked it up again.
아이디.e: From English 'ID'; in Korean it means a login username.
아이디.t: An ID card is 신분증, not 아이디.

드리다.ex: 어버이날에 부모님께 빨간 카네이션 꽃을 드렸어요.
드리다.x: On Parents' Day I gave my parents red carnations.
드리다.e: Humble counterpart of 주다, used when the receiver is higher in status.
드리다.t: Pair it with 께 instead of 에게: 선생님께 드려요; also in -아/어 드리다 'do for someone respected'.

맞이하다.m: to welcome, greet; to mark, celebrate (an occasion)
맞이하다.x: To ring in the new year, I went on a trip with my family.
맞이하다.e: From 맞다 'to receive, greet' — as in 맞은편 'the facing side'.

상승하다.m: to rise, to go up, to climb
상승하다.x: Housing prices in Seoul rose sharply this year.
상승하다.t: News word; in conversation people usually say 오르다: 집값이 올랐어요.

장기적.x: In the long run, exercise is really necessary.

평가받다.m: to be evaluated, to be rated, to be recognized
평가받다.x: That movie was rated as a masterpiece.
평가받다.e: 평가 'evaluation' + 받다 'to receive' = to receive an evaluation.
평가받다.t: Pronounced [평까받따]; -받다 makes a passive meaning, like 사랑받다 'be loved'.

꼬끼오.e: 의성어 (sound word) imitating a rooster's crow.
꼬끼오.t: Animal sounds usually take 하고 울다: 꼬끼오 하고 울다 'to crow'. Chicks say 삐약삐약.

유전자.ex: 이 병은 유전자 검사로 미리 알 수 있어요.
유전자.x: This disease can be detected early with a genetic test.
유전자.e: Literally 'heredity unit'; -자 here means a tiny unit, as in 원자 'atom'.

데이터.x: Mobile data is expensive abroad, so be careful.
데이터.t: In daily talk it often means your phone plan's data: 데이터가 다 떨어졌어요 'I'm out of data'.

고집스럽다.x: Grandpa is so stubborn that he won't go to the hospital.
고집스럽다.t: In everyday speech, 고집이 세다 is the most common way to say 'stubborn.'

나날이.m: day by day, every day, daily
나날이.x: Your Korean is improving day by day.

번지다.m: to spread (fire, disease, rumors); to run, smudge (ink, paint)
번지다.x: The fire quickly spread to the building next door.

동력.x: Exports are an important driver of economic growth.
동력.t: Pronounced [동녁]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

역량.ex: 회사는 직원들의 역량을 키우기 위해 교육을 해요.
역량.x: The company provides training to build its employees' skills.
역량.e: Literally 'amount of strength': how much you can handle.

포인트.x: If you pay with this card, you earn points.

티켓팅.ex: 티켓팅에 성공해서 콘서트에 갈 수 있게 됐어요.
티켓팅.x: I succeeded in getting tickets, so now I can go to the concert.
티켓팅.e: From English 'ticketing'. Konglish: the race to grab tickets the moment online sales open.
티켓팅.t: A brutal one is jokingly called 피켓팅 (피 'blood' + 티켓팅), 'bloody ticketing'.

독성.ex: 이 버섯은 독성이 강하니까 절대 먹지 마세요.
독성.x: This mushroom is highly toxic, so never eat it.

집행하다.m: to execute, to carry out (a sentence, budget, law)
집행하다.x: City Hall spent this year's budget as planned.
집행하다.e: Literally 'take hold and carry out' — enforcing what was decided.
집행하다.t: Common collocations: 예산을 집행하다 (spend a budget), 형을 집행하다 (carry out a sentence).

막중하다.x: As the team's representative, my responsibility is very heavy.
막중하다.t: Pairs with 책임 or 임무: 막중한 책임 'a heavy responsibility'.

헤프다.m: wasteful, extravagant (with money); too free with smiles or words
헤프다.ex: 그는 돈 씀씀이가 헤퍼서 늘 월말에 돈이 없어요.
헤프다.x: He's so free with his money that he's always broke at the end of the month.
헤프다.t: 웃음이 헤프다 just means 'smiles a lot', but calling a person 헤프다 implies promiscuity and is offensive.

일촉즉발.m: an explosive situation, touch-and-go, on a knife-edge
일촉즉발.ex: 두 나라는 일촉즉발의 위기에 놓여 있습니다.
일촉즉발.x: The two countries are in a crisis that could explode at any moment.
일촉즉발.e: Literally 'one touch and it goes off at once'.

대출금.ex: 매달 월급의 일부로 대출금을 갚고 있어요.
대출금.x: I'm paying off my loan with part of my salary every month.

우월감.ex: 그는 다른 사람에게 우월감을 느끼는 것 같아요.
우월감.x: He seems to feel superior to other people.
우월감.e: Literally 'feeling of excelling and surpassing'. -감 = feeling: 열등감, 책임감.

광풍.ex: 한때 부동산 투기 광풍이 전국을 휩쓸었어요.
광풍.x: At one point, a real estate speculation frenzy swept the whole country.

대차대조표.ex: 대차대조표를 보면 회사의 자산과 부채를 알 수 있어요.
대차대조표.x: A balance sheet shows you a company's assets and liabilities.
대차대조표.t: The official accounting term is now 재무상태표, but 대차대조표 is still widely used.

거부권.ex: 대통령이 그 법안에 대해 거부권을 행사했습니다.
거부권.x: The president exercised his veto on the bill.
거부권.e: Literally 'right to refuse'. -권 = a right: 투표권, 참정권.
거부권.t: The fixed collocation is 거부권을 행사하다, to exercise a veto.

공권력.m: governmental authority, state power (often police force)
공권력.x: State force was deployed to disperse the protesters.
공권력.t: Pronounced [공꿘녁], not [공궐력]; 공권력 투입 usually means sending in police.

자괴감.m: shame, feeling ashamed of oneself, self-reproach
자괴감.x: I feel ashamed of myself for repeating the same mistake.
자괴감.e: Literally 'feeling ashamed of oneself'. -감 = feeling: 무력감, 자책감.
자괴감.t: Used with 들다 or 느끼다: 자괴감이 들다 is the most natural pattern.

성장소설.ex: 이 성장소설은 한 소년이 어른이 되는 과정을 그려요.
성장소설.x: This coming-of-age novel depicts a boy's journey to adulthood.

독백.ex: 주인공의 긴 독백이 이 연극의 가장 감동적인 장면이에요.
독백.x: The hero's long monologue is the most moving scene in this play.

병행하다.m: to do side by side, to combine, to do in parallel
병행하다.x: He is balancing work and study at the same time.

휘감다.m: to wind around, to coil around, to wrap
휘감다.x: Ivy is winding all around the old wall.

움츠러들다.forms: 움츠러들어요 · 움츠러들었어요 · 움츠러들 거예요 · 움츠러든 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
움츠러들다.m: to shrink back, to huddle, to cower; to lose confidence
움츠러들다.x: In the cold weather my body huddled up on its own.
움츠러들다.t: Spelled 움츠-, not 움추-; also mental: 실수 후 마음이 움츠러들다 'to lose confidence'.

체계화.ex: 흩어진 자료를 체계화하는 데 시간이 많이 걸렸어요.
체계화.x: It took a long time to systematize the scattered data.
